source_evidence.captured_wording: capture a photograph; plain background; good light and plain background; fully inside; look straight ahead; glasses/spectacles; mask
source_evidence.document_title: Notice of Combined Graduate Level Examination, 2026

requirements.content_instructions: Mobile number and email verified by OTP. Aadhaar authentication is available; where Aadhaar is not used, an accepted identity number/document route is required. Accepted identity-number alternatives listed by SSC include Voter ID, PAN, Passport, Driving Licence, School/College ID and Employer ID.
requirements.evidence_status: Current official SSC CGL 2026 notice; family-level portal rule
requirements.notes: The exact non-Aadhaar document-upload flow should be checked on the active SSC OTR screen.

requirements.content_instructions: Captured through webcam/mobile/app; a pre-existing photograph must not be photographed. Use good light and plain background; camera at eye level; face fully within the guide; frontal view; no cap, mask or spectacles. Poor-quality, miniature, blurred or side-facing images may be rejected.
requirements.evidence_status: Current official SSC CGL 2026 notice; SSC portal family rule
rejection_conditions: Non-frontal or side-facing pose can fail the stated requirement.
Spectacle glare, dark or coloured glasses can make the photograph unacceptable.
Caps/hats are restricted; any permitted religious covering must leave required facial features visible.
A face mask/covering is restricted according to the stated policy.
Capturing a photograph of a pre-existing printed/digital photograph is liable to rejection under the cited SSC notice.
Poor-quality, miniature, blurred or side-facing live photographs and blurred/miniature signatures are liable to rejection.

requirements.content_instructions: JPEG/JPG; 10-20 KB. Current CGL notice gives about 6.0 cm x 2.0 cm in one section and 4.0 cm x 2.0 cm in its application annexure; this internal inconsistency is retained as conflicting. Blurred or miniature signatures are liable to rejection. PwD(VH) candidates may use thumb impression where the notice permits.
requirements.evidence_status: Current official SSC CGL 2026 notice; conflicting dimensions
rejection_conditions: Poor-quality, miniature, blurred or side-facing live photographs and blurred/miniature signatures are liable to rejection.
The current notice gives different signature widths in two sections; candidates should follow the live portal's validator.

requirements.applicability: PwBD/PwD candidates claiming reservation and/or scribe
requirements.content_instructions: Upload the applicable certificate in the prescribed annexure/form at the time of application. Exact PDF size/format was not found in the extracted notice text.
Read and accept the declaration after reviewing the application details. Concealment, misrepresentation or misdeclaration can cancel candidature.

requirements[3].file_spec.file_size.maxi.reasoning: No published file size for this certificate, and none for any of the 45 certificate deliverables in the research, so no distribution exists to stand in for. 400 KB is a product-owner working ceiling pending the published figures. No minimum is set: a floor on top of an invented ceiling would compound the guess.
